name: Eisen Manstein
original_name: アイゼン・マンシュタイン
source:
Old-school Dokutsu soldier known as Steel Beer. Brave, indomitable and undounted commander, which has many and many battle merits. Great strategist and especially tactician. Very loyal to Retia Adolf.

Hates: lazy peoples.
Likes: touring old castles.

"Fool!! Never turn your nose up!!"
